newsitem.title: UK: Capita says wins 15.0 mln stg UK contract.
newsitem.headline: Capita says wins 15.0 mln stg UK contract.

text.p: Capita Group Plc said on Monday it had been awarded a 15.0 million stg three-year contract to administer the national phase of the UK government's nursery education voucher scheme.
The contract, awarded by the Department for Education and Employment, "will be worth around 15.0 million stg over a three year period", the company said in a statement.

Capita is already administering the pilot phase of the voucher system in four local authorities areas in England and four in Scotland. It said it would provide all administrative support for the national implementation phase.
Outsourcing services company Capita said the contract award reflected well "on the group's commitment to providing clients with high quality levels of service and efficiency".
